newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - Dutch company results due Nov 18.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Dutch company results due Nov 18.

text.p: Analysts' estimates of Dutch company results for week beginning Monday, Nov 18 include:
Profit figures are net profits before extraordinary items and in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated.
Securities houses surveyed included: Amstgeld, Bangert Pontier, BZW, Delta Lloyd Bank, Generale Bank, Kempen & Co, Labouchere, Lanschot Bankiers and Wesselius.
NOTE - Banks and brokers interested in contributing to Reuters surveys can contact the Amsterdam newsroom on +31-20-504-5000 or fax their forecasts to +31-20-504 5040.
For the week starting November 25 we are collecting Q3 result forecasts for Nedlloyd, Ahold and Fortis Amev.
